The image displays a "movie barcode" which is a visualization of the average color of every shot in a film. The dominant colors in this strip are various shades of brown, sepia, tan, and dark earthy tones, with a few instances of muted grey and blue.

This specific color palette—warm, sepia-toned, and somewhat dark—is characteristic of the period drama **The Illusionist** (2006). The film, set in turn-of-the-century Vienna, utilizes a distinct cinematographic style with soft focus and warm, amber lighting to evoke a nostalgic and magical atmosphere. The vertical stripes reflect the wood-paneled interiors, candlelit scenes, and the general sepia grading of the movie.

Answer: D
